decisions.reason: The approved Hero V remains the unchanged source geometry; the requested alternatives modify only how the second V is derived from it.
The source does not change the E or L letterform architecture; it only uses their height and the L–V spacing relationship as references for separate hierarchy and kerning requirements.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing proportional scaling, the minimally refined alternative, and reopening the second V for this explicitly requested comparison.
The source preserves the É accent and does not change its required peak alignment with the Hero V.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing the L–V relationship as the spacing benchmark for the remaining letter pairs.
Copying and proportionally scaling the approved Hero V preserves its signature gesture; the source does not explicitly revise the locked terminal treatment.
The source requests changes only to the second V and spacing; the locked É accent remains unchanged and literally derived from the Hero V terminal.
The source requests visual alternatives and spacing refinement but does not change the requirement to explain design intentions with review rounds.
The source concerns black-and-white wordmark geometry and spacing and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne material treatment.
